name: Mads Christensen
bio:
Mads' journey into motorsport HR began unconventionally, with a brief stint as a mechanic's assistant during his university years. He quickly realized his organizational skills were better suited for managing people than engines. He transitioned into HR roles, honing his skills in employee relations and talent acquisition before landing at Andretti Global. 

Mads is known for his rigorous approach to HR. He believes a well-structured and motivated team is essential for success on the track. He's dedicated to finding and nurturing top talent, ensuring that Andretti Global has the best personnel in every department. His demanding nature is tempered by a commitment to fairness and professional development, making him a respected, if occasionally feared, figure within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a side part
physical.description: Mads is a tall man with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Insists on conducting all interviews in person, believing body language is as important as words.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters in his office, each with a specific HR-related lesson he draws from it.
